mapper.select: where exam_id = #{examId} and user_id = #{userId} and question_id = #{questionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE exam_answer_record SET score = #{score}, graded_at = now(), update_time = now() WHERE record_id = #{recordId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam_score_revision (record_id, exam_id, user_id, question_id, previous_score, new_score, grader_id, changed_at, reason) VALUES (#{record.recordId}, #{record.examId}, #{record.userId}, #{record.questionId}, #{record.score}NULL, #{score}, #{graderId}, now(), #{reason})
mapper.select: SELECT revision_id AS revisionId, question_id AS questionId, previous_score AS previousScore, new_score AS newScore, grader_id AS graderId, changed_at AS changedAt, reason FROM exam_score_revision WHERE exam_id = #{examId} AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY revision_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam_answer_record (exam_id, user_id, question_id, answer, score, create_time, update_time) SELECT e.exam_id, s.user_id, q.question_id, #{answer}, NULL, now(), now() FROM exam_info e JOIN exam_student s ON s.exam_id = e.exam_id AND s.user_id = #{userId} JOIN exam_question_snapshot q ON q.exam_id = e.exam_id AND q.question_id = #{questionId} JOIN exam_session sess ON sess.exam_id = e.exam_id AND sess.user_id = s.user_id WHERE e.exam_id = #{examId} AND e.status = '0' AND e.published_at IS NOT NULL AND sess.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND e.start_time <= now() AND e.end_time > now() ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE answer = VALUES(answer), update_time = now()

INSERT INTO exam_answer_record (exam_id, user_id, question_id, answer, score, create_time, update_time) SELECT q.exam_id, sess.user_id, q.question_id, '', NULL, NOW(), NOW() FROM exam_question_snapshot q JOIN exam_session sess ON sess.exam_id = q.exam_id AND sess.user_id = #{userId} WHERE q.exam_id = #{examId} AND sess.status IN ('SUBMITTED', 'AUTO_SUBMITTED', 'GRADED') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM exam_answer_record a WHERE a.exam_id = q.exam_id AND a.user_id = sess.user_id AND a.question_id = q.question_id)
